prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic 1:1 1990s high-fashion studio portrait of an adult woman matching the required approved adult non-public-figure identity reference. She has a feminine silhouette, long dark softly waved hair with bangs, defined eyes, glossy lips, and natural skin texture. She wears a fitted black velvet short dress with white piping details, decorative arrow graphics pointing inward on the front, short sleeves with white trim, an open-front button detail, and black high-heeled sandals. Seat her on a tall stool with legs crossed at the knees, hands resting naturally on her thighs, and an intense direct gaze toward the camera. Use dramatic high-contrast studio lighting, a neutral gradient backdrop, medium-format film character, subtle grain, crisp velvet texture, realistic proportions, and no text or logos.
